# ============================================
# CAM SETUP & POCKET MACHINING ROUTINE

# --- Part Geometry Analysis ---
scene = mb.inspect()
bodies = scene['bodies']
bbox_min = bodies[0]['bbox_min_mm']
bbox_max = bodies[0]['bbox_max_mm']
w = bbox_max[0] - bbox_min[0]   # 100mm
h = bbox_max[1] - bbox_min[1]   # 100mm
t = bbox_max[2] - bbox_min[2]   # 50mm
print(f"Part: {w:.1f} x {h:.1f} x {t:.1f} mm")

# Get pocket floor face (upward-facing plane inside the cavity)
faces = mb.faces(0, kind="Plane")
upward_faces = [(f, f.get('normal', [0,0,0])[2]) for f in faces if f.get('normal', [0,0,0])[2] > 0.9]
for f_data, nz in sorted(upward_faces, key=lambda x: x[0]['z_mm']):
    print(f"  Upward face idx={f_data['index']:2d} z={f_data['z_mm']:6.1f} area={f_data['area_mm2']:8.1f} centroid={f_data.get('centroid_mm')}")

# Pocket floor is face 5 at z=30mm, centroid at origin -> centered pocket
pocket_floor_idx = 5
print(f"\nTarget pocket floor: face {pocket_floor_idx} (z=30mm, area=3578.5mm²)")
pocket_depth_from_top = 50.0 - 30.0  # 20mm
print(f"Pocket depth from part top: {pocket_depth_from_top:.1f}mm")

# ============================================
# STEP 1: SELECT TOOLS
# ============================================
print("\n=== TOOL SELECTION ===")

# Find suitable carbide endmills
all_tools = mb.list_library_tools()
carbide_rough_candidates = []
carbide_finish_candidates = []
for t in all_tools:
    desc = t.get('description', '').lower()
    if 'carb' in desc and 'flat' in desc and 'endmill' in desc:
        d = t.get('diameter_mm', 0)
        if d >= 12:  # ~12mm or larger for roughing
            carbide_rough_candidates.append(t)
        elif d >= 6 and d < 12:  # 6-12mm for finishing
            carbide_finish_candidates.append(t)

print("Carbide rough candidates:")
for t in carbide_rough_candidates:
    print(f"  idx={t['index']:2d} diam={t['diameter_mm']:.2f}mm cr={t.get('corner_radius_mm')}mm flutes={t.get('flutes')} | {t['description']}")

print("Carbide finish candidates:")
for t in carbide_finish_candidates:
    print(f"  idx={t['index']:2d} diam={t['diameter_mm']:.2f}mm cr={t.get('corner_radius_mm')}mm flutes={t.get('flutes')} | {t['description']}")

# Select tools
rough_tool = min(carbide_rough_candidates, key=lambda t: abs(t['diameter_mm'] - 12.7))  # Prefer ~12.7mm
finish_tool = min(carbide_finish_candidates, key=lambda t: abs(t['diameter_mm'] - 8.0))  # Prefer ~8mm

print(f"\nSelected roughing: [{rough_tool['index']}] {rough_tool['description']} ({rough_tool['diameter_mm']}mm)")
print(f"Selected finishing: [{finish_tool['index']}] {finish_tool['description']} ({finish_tool['diameter_mm']}mm)")

di_rough = mb.add_tool(rough_tool['library_url'], rough_tool['index'])['document_tool_index']
di_finish = mb.add_tool(finish_tool['library_url'], finish_tool['index'])['document_tool_index']
print(f"Document tool indices: rough={di_rough}, finish={di_finish}")

# ============================================
# STEP 2: CREATE CAM SETUP
# ============================================
print("\n=== CREATE SETUP ===")
setup_name = mb.create_setup(
    body_index=0,
    wcs_origin='top center',              # WCS at top-center of stock box (Z=0 at top)
    stock={'mode': 'relative', 'side_mm': 0, 'top_mm': 0, 'bottom_mm': 0},
    name='Pocket_Machine_Setup'
)['setup']
print(f"Setup created: '{setup_name}'")

# ============================================
# STEP 3: ROUGHING OPERATION
# ============================================
print("\n=== ROUGHING OPERATION ===")
# Strategy: adaptive2d for efficient pocket roughing
# Parameters (Aluminum alloy):
#   - Tool: 12.7mm carbide endmill
#   - Stepover: 50% of diameter = 6.35mm (good for adaptive)
#   - Stepdown: 3mm per pass (aggressive for carbide in Al, 20mm total depth → ~7 passes)
#   - Feed: 2000 mm/min (RPM~4000, fz~0.11mm/tooth × 3 flute)
#   - Plunge: 300 mm/min (conservative)

# Feeds & speeds for aluminum with carbide 3-flute endmill at 12.7mm
# Typical: Vc=150m/min → RPM = 150000/(π×12.7) ≈ 3760, round to 4000
# fz=0.08mm/tooth → Fc = 4000×3×0.08 = 960mm/min...
# Let me use higher: fz=0.15mm/tooth for heavy rough → Fc = 4000×3×0.15 = 1800mm/min

feed_params = {
    'cutting_mm_min': 1800,   # Heavy roughing feed
    'plunge_mm_min': 300,     # Conservative plunge
    'ramp_mm_min': 600,       # Moderate ramp
    'spindle_rpm': 4000       # Reasonable for 12.7mm in Al
}

height_params = {
    'clearance_mm': 5.0,      # Safe height above stock
    'retract_mm': 2.0         # Retract between passes
}

op_rough_name = mb.add_operation(
    setup=setup_name,
    strategy='adaptive2d',       # Efficient for pockets
    tool=di_rough,               # Document tool index
    stepover_mm=6.35,            # 50% of tool diameter
    stepdown_mm=3.0,             # 3mm per pass for 20mm depth
    geometry={'faces': [pocket_floor_idx], 'type': 'pocket'},
    feeds=feed_params,
    heights=height_params,
    name='Pocket_Rough_Adaptive'
)['operation']
print(f"Roughing op created: '{op_rough_name}'")

# ============================================
# STEP 4: FINISHING OPERATION
# ============================================
print("\n=== FINISHING OPERATION ===")
# Strategy: contour2d for wall finishing + face for floor finishing
# Or use pocket2d with smaller stepover for clean pocket finish
# For comprehensive finishing, I'll do:
# 1. pocket2d for floor + walls (small stepover for tight tolerance)
# 2. Optional: trace for walls if needed

# Feeds & speeds for finishing with 8mm carbide endmill
# Vc=200m/min → RPM ≈ 8000
# fz=0.04mm/tooth → Fc = 8000×2×0.04 = 640mm/min (clean finish)

feed_fin = {
    'cutting_mm_min': 640,       # Finishing feed rate
    'plunge_mm_min': 200,        # Light plunge
    'ramp_mm_min': 400,          # Gentle ramp
    'spindle_rpm': 8000           # Higher spindle for smaller tool
}

op_fin_name = mb.add_operation(
    setup=setup_name,
    strategy='pocket2d',         # Full pocket finish pass
    tool=di_finish,              # Smaller tool for detail
    stepover_mm=0.76,            # 10% of 7.9375mm diameter for fine finish
    stepdown_mm=0.25,            # Light finishing pass (may leave slight stock if roughing was deeper)
    geometry={'faces': [pocket_floor_idx], 'type': 'pocket'},
    feeds=feed_fin,
    heights=height_params,
    name='Pocket_Finish_Pocket2D'
)['operation']
print(f"Finish op created: '{op_fin_name}'")

# Wall finishing pass using contour2d on vertical faces
vertical_faces = [f for f in faces if (f.get('normal', [0,0,0])[2]) == 0]
pocket_wall_faces = [f['index'] for f in vertical_faces if f['z_mm'] == 30.0]
print(f"Vertical faces at z=30: {pocket_wall_faces}")

if pocket_wall_faces:
    op_wall_name = mb.add_operation(
        setup=setup_name,
        strategy='contour2d',        # Wall contour finish
        tool=di_finish,
        stepover_mm=0.76,
        stepdown_mm=0.25,           # Fine pass along walls
        geometry={'faces': pocket_wall_faces[:1], 'type': 'contour'},  # First wall face only
        feeds=feed_fin,
        heights=height_params,
        name='Pocket_Wall_Finish'
    )['operation']
    print(f"Wall finish op created: '{op_wall_name}'")
else:
    print("No separate wall faces detected; pocket2d should handle walls via pocket topology.")

# ============================================
# STEP 5: GENERATE TOOLPATHS
# ============================================
print("\n=== GENERATING TOOLPATHS ===")
result = mb.generate(setup=setup_name)
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))

# Check results
for op_info in result.get('operations', []):
    has_tp = op_info['has_toolpath']
    is_valid = op_info['is_valid']
    status = "✓ OK" if (has_tp and is_valid) else ("✗ NEEDS FIX" if not has_tp else "⚠ INVALID")
    print(f"  {op_info['name']:30s}: has_toolpath={has_tp} is_valid={is_valid} {status}")

# ============================================
# STEP 6: PROBE VERIFICATION
# ============================================
print("\n=== FINAL PROBE ===")
probe = mb.probe()
print(json.dumps(probe, indent=2))
